'''Leeh''' is an [[Aiel]] ''[[Far Dareis Mai]]''.

== Activities ==
While in [[Tear]], she is sent by [[Rand al'Thor]] to follow [[Weiramon Saniago]] and [[Anaiyella Narencelona]] who have just been revealed as [[Darkfriend]]s.
== Trivia ==
* Leeh is named for Leigh Butler, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
